name: CSO_DB_TOPIC_LOG
description: This table contains log information for topic and messages. Usually used to determine which records have been deleted.

columns.name: DATE_ADDED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was added to the repository.

columns.name: DATE_MODIFIED
columns.description: Datetime record was last modified in repository.

columns.name: FORUM_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to the forum

columns.name: LOCALE_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to the locale.

columns.name: LOCALE_CODE
columns.description: This is the locale code for this record.

columns.name: MESSAGE_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to the message.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: TOPIC_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to the topic.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: This is the obsolete GUID reference to the user.

columns.name: USER_NAME
columns.description: This is the User Full name on this record.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the ID of the user associated with this log record.
